# Meshery Documentation

> As a self-service engineering platform, Meshery enables collaborative design and operation of cloud native infrastructure.

## Docs

- [Meshery Documentation](/pr-preview/pr-21670/index.md): Documentation home: entry points for installation, concepts, guides, extensions, and reference.
- [Search Results](/pr-preview/pr-21670/search/index.md)

## Installation

- [Installation](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/index.md): Installation procedures for deploying Meshery with mesheryctl.
- [Accessing Meshery UI](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/accessing-meshery-ui/index.md): Accessing Meshery's web-based user interface
- [Advanced Configuration](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/advanced/index.md): Advanced installation and runtime configuration topics for Meshery.
- [Codespaces](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/advanced/codespaces/index.md): Build and contribute to Meshery using GitHub Codespaces
- [Server Environment Variables](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/advanced/environment-variables/index.md): Installation and runtime configuration reference for the environment variables consumed by Meshery Server.
- [Using Multiple Adapters](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/advanced/multiple-adapters/index.md): Meshery is capable of running zero or more adapters. Meshery offers many features without the need for adapters. Adapters are optional components that enhance and extend Meshery's core functionality.
- [Install on Docker](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/docker/index.md): Install Meshery on Docker
- [Docker Extension](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/docker/docker-extension/index.md): Install Docker Extension for Meshery
- [Install on Kubernetes](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/index.md): Install Meshery on Kubernetes. Deploy Meshery in Kubernetes in-cluster or outside of Kubernetes out-of-cluster.
- [AKS](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/aks/index.md): Manage your AKS clusters with Meshery. Deploy Meshery in AKS in-cluster or out-of-cluster.
- [DigitalOcean](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/digitalocean/index.md): Install Meshery on DigitalOcean. Deploy Meshery out-of-cluster with Docker on a Droplet, or in-cluster on DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS).
- [EKS](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/eks/index.md): Install Meshery on Elastic Kubernetes Service. Deploy Meshery in EKS in-cluster or outside of EKS out-of-cluster.
- [GKE](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/gke/index.md): Install Meshery on Google Kubernetes Engine. Deploy Meshery in GKE in-cluster or outside of GKE out-of-cluster.
- [Helm](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/helm/index.md): Install Meshery on Kubernetes using Helm. Deploy Meshery in Kubernetes in-cluster.
- [KinD](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/kind/index.md): Install Meshery on KinD. Deploy Meshery in KinD in-cluster or outside of KinD out-of-cluster.
- [KubeSphere](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/kubesphere/index.md): Install Meshery on KubeSphere
- [Minikube](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/kubernetes/minikube/index.md): Install Meshery on Minikube. Deploy Meshery in Minikube in-cluster or outside of Minikube out-of-cluster.
- [Install using mesheryctl](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/mesheryctl/index.md): Use Meshery CLI to install Meshery on supported platforms.
- [Install Meshery CLI on Linux or macOS](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/mesheryctl/linux-mac/index.md): Install Meshery CLI on Linux or macOS
- [Bash](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/mesheryctl/linux-mac/bash/index.md): Install Meshery CLI on Linux or MacOS with Bash
- [Brew](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/mesheryctl/linux-mac/brew/index.md): Install Meshery CLI on Linux or macOS with Homebrew

- [Scoop](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/mesheryctl/windows/scoop/index.md): Install Meshery CLI on Windows with Scoop
- [Overview](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/overview/index.md): Meshery is the self-service engineering platform, enabling collaborative design and operation of cloud and cloud native infrastructure.
- [Using Meshery Playground](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/playground/index.md): An alternative to installing Meshery
- [Production Deployment](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/index.md): Considerations, best practices, security hardening, performance bounds, and operational readiness guidance for deploying Meshery in production.
- [Authentication, Authorization & Identity](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/authentication-and-identity/index.md): Why to preselect a Remote Provider over the Local Provider, OAuth callback configuration, identity providers, capabilities, and keys/permissions for production Meshery.

- [Infrastructure, Sizing & Performance](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/infrastructure-sizing-and-performance/index.md): Resource requirements per Meshery component, capacity planning, MeshSync tiered discovery, Broker throughput, scalability levers, and the known performance bounds to plan around in production.
- [Monitoring, Observability & Health KPIs](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/monitoring-observability-and-kpis/index.md): Health endpoints, the key performance indicators of Meshery's health, metrics, distributed tracing, centralized logging, alerting, and synthetic checks for observing Meshery in production.
- [Multi-Cluster & Multi-Cloud Operations](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/multi-cluster-and-multi-cloud/index.md): Managed vs. unmanaged cluster connections, one Operator per cluster, kubeconfig and context management, MeshSync deployment modes, and cloud-specific guidance for operating Meshery across many …

- [Operational Readiness Checklist & Known Caveats](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/operational-readiness-checklist/index.md): A consolidated, actionable production-readiness checklist across every dimension, the upgrade strategy for Meshery, and the known caveats and limitations to plan around.
- [Security Hardening](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/production/security-hardening/index.md): RBAC and least privilege, pod and container security contexts, secret and kubeconfig handling, TLS, supply-chain integrity, Broker exposure risk, namespace isolation, and extension trust for hardening …
- [Quick Start Guide](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/quick-start/index.md): Getting Meshery up and running locally on a Docker-enabled system or in Kubernetes is easy. Meshery deploys as a set of Docker containers, which can be deployed to either a Docker host or a Kubernetes …
- [Upgrading](/pr-preview/pr-21670/installation/upgrades/index.md): How to upgrade Meshery and each of its components

## Concepts

- [Concepts](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/index.md): Concepts for understanding Meshery's various features and components.
- [Architecture](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/index.md): Overview of different individual components of Meshery architecture and how they interact as a system.
- [Adapters](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/adapters/index.md): Adapters extend Meshery's management capabilities in any number of ways, including lifecycle, configuration, performance, governance, identity...
- [Broker](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/broker/index.md): Meshery broker component facilitates data streaming between kubernetes cluster components and outside world.
- [Catalog](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/catalog/index.md): Browsing and using cloud native patterns
- [Database](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/database/index.md): Meshery offers support for internal caching with the help of file databases. This has been implemented with several libraries that supports different kinds of data formats.
- [Deployment Engine](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/deployment-engine/index.md): How Meshery fulfills a design - resolving the registrant behind each component and routing that component either to Meshery Server itself or to a Meshery Adapter.
- [MeshSync](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/meshsync/index.md): MeshSync ensures Meshery Server is continuously in-sync with the state of infrastructure under management.
- [Operator](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/architecture/operator/index.md): Meshery Operator controls and manages the lifecycle of components deployed inside a kubernetes cluster
- [Logical](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/index.md): Logical Concepts for understanding Meshery's various features and components.
- [Components](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/components/index.md): Meshery Components identify and characterize infrastructure under management.
- [Connections](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/connections/index.md): Meshery Connections are managed and unmanaged resources that either through discovery or manual entry are managed by a state machine and used within one or more Environments.
- [Credentials](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/credentials/index.md): Meshery uses one or more Credentials when authenticating to a managed or unmanaged Connection.
- [Designs](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/designs/index.md): Meshery Designs are descriptive, declarative characterizations of how your Kubernetes infrastructure should be configured.
- [Environments](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/environments/index.md): Environments are how you organize your deployment targets (whether on-premises servers or cloud services) into resource groups.
- [Models](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/models/index.md): Meshery uses a set of resource models to define concrete boundaries to ensure extensible and sustainable management.
- [Organizations](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/organizations/index.md): Organizations are the unit of tenancy in Meshery — they group users together and own all of the resources those users create.
- [Patterns](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/patterns/index.md): Meshery Patterns are descriptive, declarative characterizations of how your Kubernetes infrastructure should be configured.
- [Policies](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/policies/index.md): Meshery Policies enable you with a broad set of controls and governance of the behavior of systems under Meshery's management.
- [Registry](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/registry/index.md): Meshery Registry is a database acting as the central repository for all capabilities known to Meshery. These capabilities encompass various entities, including models, components, relationships, and …
- [Relationships](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/relationships/index.md): Meshery Relationships identify and facilitate genealogy between Components.
- [Workspaces](/pr-preview/pr-21670/concepts/logical/workspaces/index.md): Meshery Workspaces act as central collaboration point for teams.

- [Bringing Existing Infrastructure Under Meshery Management](/pr-preview/pr-21670/guides/infrastructure-management/managing-existing-infrastructure/index.md): What happens when you point Meshery at a cluster that is already running workloads - how brownfield discovery works, what to evaluate before you connect, the end-to-end process, and the caveats.

## Reference and Extensibility

- [Reference and Extensibility](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/index.md): References for using Meshery's various features and components.
- [Extensibility](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/index.md): Meshery has an extensible architecture with several different types of extension points.
- [Extensibility: APIs](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/api/index.md): Meshery architecture is extensible, offering an array of extension points and REST and GraphQL APIs.
- [Extensibility: Authorization](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/authorization/index.md): Meshery architecture is extensible. Meshery provides several extension points for working with different cloud native projects via authorization, adapters, load generators and providers.
- [Extensibility: Build-time](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/build-time/index.md): System integrators can supply build-time configuration, data, packages, and other extensions to Meshery's container image.
- [Extensibility: Load Generators](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/load-generators/index.md): Meshery offers support for more types of Kubernetes and cloud native infrastructure than any other project or product in the world. Meshery uses adapters for more deeply managing specific types of …
- [Extensibility: Providers](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/providers/index.md): Meshery uses providers to enrich the level of depth by which it manages cloud native infrastructure.
- [Extensibility: Schemas](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/schemas/index.md): Meshery schemas support x-* vendor extensions as an intentional extensibility mechanism for remote providers to attach provider-specific metadata.
- [Extensibility: UI](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/ui/index.md): Meshery offers support for more adapters than any other project or product in the world. Meshery UI has a number of extension points that allow users to customize their experience with third-party …
- [Ensuring Extension Compatibility](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/extensibility/verify-compatibility/index.md): A guide for Meshery extension developers on maintaining compatibility with the Meshery platform, covering shared frameworks, dependencies, and build tooling.
- [Reference](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/references/index.md): References for using Meshery's various features and components.
- [Error Codes](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/references/error-codes/index.md): Meshery Error Code Reference for all Meshery components so that you can troubleshoot issues.
- [GraphQL API Reference](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/references/graphql-apis/index.md): Meshery GraphQL API Documentation and Reference
- [Meshery Operator CRDs](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/references/meshery-operator-crds/index.md): Details of the Custom Resource Definitions included in Meshery Operator and used by its custom controllers.
- [Command Line Reference](/pr-preview/pr-21670/reference/references/mesheryctl/index.md): A guide to Meshery's CLI: mesheryctl
